1-3 yearsof experience performing general carpentry work, including construction, installation, maintenance, and repair of building components and fixtures.

Constructs new partitions, installs drywall, paneling, and hangs commercial and residential doors and frames working from blueprints, drawings, written and/or oral instructions. Installs and/or repairs floor tiles, installs suspended ceilings, cabinets, and demountable partitions, and minor furniture repair. Fabricates and installs Formica covered counter tops, cabinets, bulletin boards, chalkboards and repairs or rebuilds furniture. Maintains time and materials documentation for each job assigned.
